jtbd.jtbd_desc: Choose a solvable user pain; define prototype scope; publish toolkit for early users.

interactions.user_ask: What problem should I choose for Breakthrough?
interactions.jenny_reply: Pick one you already touch weekly. Smaller pain, faster proof—choose one metric you can move in 2 weeks.

interactions.user_ask: How do I package the toolkit?
interactions.jenny_reply: Publish a README + 60‑sec demo + one‑pager; distribute to 5 users and ask for a before/after screenshot.
Two iterations minimum: ship v0.1 in 3 days, v0.2 next week based on user feedback.

outcomes.name: breakthrough_roadmap_v1
outcomes.details: Two sprints defined; beta user list drafted.
